Independent non-executive director


- BCom Hons (Accounting); BCom Hons (Management Accounting); CA(SA); MBA South African
- Born 1980
- Appointed to the Board in 2026
- Member of the Audit Committee


Ms Mametja Moshe is a Chartered Accountant (SA) and the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Moshe Capital, a South African advisory and investment firm. She has more than 23 years’ experience across corporate finance, equity and debt capital markets, accounting, auditing, corporate tax, strategy and investment. Her career includes investment banking and advisory experience with Morgan Stanley and UBS AG, as well as auditing and corporate tax experience with KPMG. Her sector experience spans mining, financial services, telecommunications, manufacturing, agriculture and transport. Ms Moshe currently serves on the boards of Impala Platinum Holdings Limited and Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited.


Company Name


Sasol Limited
